title: P.3 The Cartesian Plane and Graphs of Equations

icans: I can use the Distance and Midpoint Formulas.
I can find intercepts and test a graph for symmetry.

vocab: the points where a graph __________ the x-axis or the y-axis

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

blocks.stem: Find the distance and the midpoint between (−2, 1) and (3, 4).

notes: Intercepts: for x-intercepts let y = _______________; for y-intercepts let x = 0.

blocks.stem: Find the intercepts of y = x² − 4x.

notes: Symmetry tests: replace y with −y (x-axis), x with −x (y-axis), or both (the _______________).
